Your main responsibilities: - Welcoming and supporting drivers at the beginning and end of their shifts; - Answering practical questions and providing basic support during their shifts; - Monitoring punctuality and data quality in TCT and Simacan, and identifying any deviations from the schedule; - Ensuring compliance with safety and quality procedures; - Recording journey details, incidents and other relevant information; - Explaining systems and transport documents to drivers; - Occasionally assisting with loading and unloading activities; - Ensuring a clear handover to the next shift. You will mainly work at weekends, on either day or night shifts, depending on mutual agreement. This role is ideal for combining with your studies or another job. Who are we looking for? - You are currently studying or looking for a flexible weekend job; - You have completed at least secondary vocational education or are currently enrolled in an MBO or higher professional education programme; - You enjoy taking responsibility; - You can work independently and quickly learn new tasks; - You have an interest in logistics and transport; - You are fluent in Dutch and can communicate well in English.
